headline: Frontlines Shift as Bases Change Hands Across Sectors
war_summary: Since the 09:15 edition the war has sharpened on a half‑dozen fronts. Godcrofts has erupted with five ownership flips in the past two hours and 49 in the last day, while casualties remain modest. Fishermans Row continues its relentless churn, logging 30 flips in 24 hours and heavy losses on both sides. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest theatre, added four fresh flips in the last two hours and 32 in the day, with casualties running near 590 Colonial and 1,260 Warden per two‑hour window. Linn Mercy recorded two new flips in two hours and 16 in 24 hours, its casualty rate climbing to roughly 136 Colonial and 340 Warden per two hours. Stlican Shelf showed two recent flips and a 24‑hour total of 31, while Stonecradle, quiet in the last two hours, posted four flips in the past six and 31 overall with sustained high attrition (≈210 Colonial, 313 Warden per two hours). Callahan’s Passage, previously static, now registers three flips. Mooring County and Viper Pit each saw modest activity, and all other sectors reported no ownership changes.
